packageRules.description: The harnesses swb runs. Each takes its latest release as soon as it ships, so swb meets a new harness before its users do; everything else keeps the release-age gate.
Thurston's own packages, which swb moves in lockstep with: each takes its latest release as soon as it ships, like the harnesses.
A Pi update raises the package.json floors, not only bun.lock, so the declared range always names the Pi swb is tested against.
The harnesses the e2e runs from node_modules, pinned exactly so every host and CI test one version, and each release arrives as its own PR rather than inside lock file maintenance.

Pinned to the version pi ships. Pi's extension loader aliases typebox to its own bundled copy, so our declaration only types what pi executes and must match it. It moves when pi moves, not on Renovate's schedule.
conda-forge has no lookup Renovate can resolve for these, so every run fails on them. mise pins them by hand.

Pi's docs/packages.md has a package declare the packages Pi provides as peerDependencies at "*", so it loads in whichever Pi hosts it. Renovate leaves those peers alone; the devDependencies carry the Pi the package is built against.
